thread:
maria.g: Pager: encoder deployment rollout (encoder:v2) triggered crashloops in eu-west-1 after 03:10 UTC, seeing 5xx spike and increased tail latency. Investigating.

sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: encoder-v2 liveness failures on 6 pods. CrashLoopBackOff. Restart rate increasing. Alert links: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/ENC-6001239876

josh.oncall: ack — I'm taking this. Any recent infra changes?

david.eng: we started a node drain for infra patch at ~03:08 but were supposed to pause for prod. HPA reacted and scaled pods while nodes were cordoned. Might be interaction.

maria.g: grabbing pod logs now. Initial signs: prestart oom and repeated initialization failures in the model loader.

maria.g: ```
I0420 03:12:21.123456 1 runtime.go:45] loading model chunk 4/12
E0420 03:12:22.234567 1 oom_killer.c:98] Memory cgroup: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (encoder) score 987
Error: failed to allocate memory for KV cache
```

carla-support: customers hitting 502/503 in EU region. Statuspage has several reports. Early estimate: ~12% of inference requests failing for eu-west tenants. No data loss reported.

josh.oncall: propose immediate mitigation: 1) flip feature flag for encoder_v2 to off 2) rollback deployment to encoder:v1 3) temporarily lower HPA minReplicas. Which is fastest?

sre-bot: Runbooks: "rollback-deploy" OR "feature-flag-kill-switch". Both acceptable. Flag toggle is fastest if it short-circuits traffic.

david.eng: flag toggle might still leave pods alive if traffic is routed, rollback is cleaner. I'll prepare rollback command.

ops-runner: running: `ffctl set encoder_v2_enabled false --env=prod --force`

josh.oncall: executed flag toggle. Waiting for traffic shift. If errors persist, rollback.

david.eng: rolling back now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/encoder -n prod --to-revision=42`

maria.g: rollback started. Watching pods come up. HPA is still seeing churn from node drain — scaling events spiked. Suggest temp patch to HPA: set minReplicas=2.

ops-runner: applied patch: `kubectl patch hpa encoder -n prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'`

josh.oncall: monitoring metrics — error rate dropping. Carla, can you confirm customer-facing impact?

carla-support: errors dropped to ~1.8% in EU ~03:42 UTC. Several customers acknowledged degraded but recovering. Posting update to statuspage.

maria.g: oncall handoff to david.eng at 04:00 UTC. Incident declared mitigated; remain in watch for 1 hour. Action items: 1) revert accidental node drain automation for prod 2) add HPA surge guard (cap deltas per minute) 3) add pre-drain prod hold check 4) postmortem to include memory profile of encoder:v2.

david.eng: got it — I'll take postmortem lead and schedule follow-up with infra and product. tagging ops and platform. :thumbsup:
